Whatever — the misconfiguration caused price to be reported as ~$1.12 instead of ~$2,200).
4. Liquidation bots immediately liquidated cbETH collateral positions — repaying ~$1 of debt to seize 1 cbETH. 1,096 cbETH seized across 129 liquidations. Protocol left with $1.78M bad debt.
5. Governance reduced borrow cap to 0.01, supply cap to 0.01.
6. Oracle still reads $1.12 as of Feb 17.
7. Fixing requires governance: MIP-B57 proposed Feb 18 to revert cbETH market oracle back to standard Chainlink composite. But governance voting + timelock takes ~5 days per Anthias (O15). So the fix won't be executable until ~Feb 23 or later.
8. Feb 18 22:08: Delegate proposes recovery plan for affected users.

Now, the user's position: cbETH supplied as collateral, USDC borrowed. HF ~1.6 at market prices.
